headline: Nevish Line And Stlican Shelf Erupt In Fierce Clashes
war_summary: Frontline combat over the past three hours has surged intensely in Nevish Line and Linn of Mercy, while Stlican Shelf fractured into active base captures after hours of deadlock. In Nevish Line, unrelenting assaults produced nine base exchanges across contested positions including Grief Mother and Princefal, costing over 3,200 combined casualties in the last two hours. Linn of Mercy resumed active fighting around Rotdust and Outwich Ranch, tallying two fresh base transitions alongside nearly 3,600 fallen troops. Meanwhile, Warden forces pushed into Stlican Shelf, securing Briar in a sudden three-event clash that broke regional stagnation. In contrast, tactical movement slowed across Weathered Expanse and Callahan's Passage, where no base flips occurred in the last two hours despite continuing heavy artillery duels and steep casualty tallies in Weathered Expanse exceeding 2,500. Peripheral sectors like Marban Hollow and Mooring County maintained high enlistments and sustained skirmishing without immediate ground shifts.
